topics.title: workshop seat transfer
topics.rule: A participant can give a workshop place to another named person only after both people give written consent.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for workshop seat transfer.

topics.title: workshop fee reimbursement
topics.rule: A workshop attendance fee is returned only when the organizer cancels the event. Giving the place to another participant does not return the fee.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for workshop fee reimbursement.

topics.title: digital key renewal
topics.rule: A temporary electronic entry key can be renewed when its current sponsor confirms that access is still needed. A former sponsor cannot renew it.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for digital key renewal.

topics.title: digital key revocation
topics.rule: When a temporary visitor leaves permanently, the current sponsor asks staff to revoke the electronic entry key immediately. Renewal is not the correct action.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for digital key revocation.

topics.title: courier pickup rescheduling
topics.rule: Changing a booked courier collection time requires notice by noon on the preceding working day. Later requests keep the original time window.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for courier pickup rescheduling.

topics.title: courier handover signature
topics.rule: The delivery driver signs a handover record when collecting a parcel. A rescheduling request is not proof that collection occurred.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for courier handover signature.

topics.title: staff meal subsidy limit
topics.rule: A staff lunch subsidy covers at most nine fictional tokens per working day. Amounts above that limit are paid by the employee.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for staff meal subsidy limit.

topics.title: visitor meal sponsorship
topics.rule: A visitor lunch is paid by the inviting sponsor after a guest meal request is approved. The staff daily lunch subsidy does not apply to visitors.
topics.record: Staff record the request, requester and decision in the service log for visitor meal sponsorship.
